member.remarks: When some pixels look like dead pixels, user may want to set those pixels as bad pixels manually and do calibration for those pixels afterwards. It provides those functionality. member.name: M:i3_cs.TE_B.UpdateDead
member.para: 0 : failed to update\n1: succeeded to update
member.remarks: In some cases, bad pixels can be generated while using TE which does not exist before, so it is considered non-dead pixel in flash data. This function receive images and analyze if additional bad pixels exist. If bad pixels exist, it will update dead data and calibration process will be applied to those pixels afterwards. Update data is not stored after disconnection. So, User should call this function for every reconnection if user want to update bad pixels.

member.name: M:i3_cs.TE_A.UpdateTempData(System.Single,System.Single,System.Single,System.Single)
member.param: Actual temperature of object 1
Temperature of object 1 measured by Thermal Expert
Actual temperature of object 2
Temperature of object 2 measured by Thermal Expert
member.returns: true if update succeeded, false otherwise
member.remarks: Thermal Expert is calibrated on manufacturing, but its temperature can be shifted by a specific usecase or any other reasons. It that case, it needs to be recalibrated. This function recalibrate temperature data. To do that, user should measure two known temperature points. By using those known temperature (_target1, _targe2) and measured temperature (_meas1, _meas2), it will recalibrate to correct measured temperature to actual temperature. After executing this function, user should not disconnect power for at least 7 seconds. Otherwise, updated data may not be saved on disconnect.
